client_side.blocker: BeeGFS's client is a kernel module. The container has no /lib/modules for the running host kernel (7.3.3-1-cachyos), Debian bookworm carries no headers for that kernel, and the package's own autobuild stops with 'Linux kernel build directory not found'. Even if the module could be built it would have to be inserted into the host kernel with CAP_SYS_MODULE, which the court forbids and which is not a container-local act.
client_side.not_a_packaging_gap: beegfs-client 7.4.6 installs and runs its autobuild; the failure is the absent kernel build tree and the impossibility of loading a module, not a missing binary

container.why_no_capabilities: every BeeGFS service here is userspace; no capability was needed to start management, metadata and storage

consequence: No A/N/B/C/D/E arm was run on BeeGFS and no number in any programme document may cite BeeGFS. The row remains 'blocked' with this receipt as its evidence.
